metadata.review_notes: Curated from Gujarat Industries and Mines Department Resolution SSI-102020-Gujarat. Verified state top-up rules.

scheme_name: Gujarat Industrial Policy 2020 - Scheme for Financial Assistance to MSMEs (Capital Investment Subsidy)
authority: Industries and Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
objective: To provide financial incentives for manufacturing MSMEs in Gujarat to undertake technology modernization, capacity expansion, and high-value industrial production.
exclusions: Trading, warehousing, and commercial service enterprises
Enterprises defaulting on state taxes or electricity dues
Statutory negative list under Appendix-A of Resolution

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Ineligible: Enterprise manufacturing facility must be physically situated within the state of Gujarat.

evidence.issuing_authority: Government of Gujarat Industries & Mines Department
evidence.exact_quote: This scheme shall apply to micro, small and medium manufacturing enterprises established and operating within the geographical territory of Gujarat State.

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Ineligible: Only capital expenditure on new, unused plant and machinery qualifies for state capital subsidy.
eligibility_rules.ambiguity_notes: Imported refurbished machinery requires Chartered Engineer certificate of minimum 10-year residual life.

evidence.issuing_authority: Government of Gujarat Industries & Mines Department
evidence.exact_quote: Only new plant and machinery purchased from recognized manufacturers or authorized distributors shall be eligible for subsidy computation.

financial_conditions.parameter_name: Maximum Assistance Cap in Category-1/2 Talukas

evidence.issuing_authority: Government of Gujarat Industries & Mines Department
evidence.exact_quote: For Small and Micro enterprises in Category-1 and Category-2 talukas, capital subsidy is 25% of eligible fixed capital investment up to a maximum of ₹25 Lakhs.

registration_requirements.timing: Within 1 year of commercial production / installation
registration_requirements.verification_method: Online IFP Investor Login & DIC scrutiny

prerequisites: Valid Udyam Registration showing Gujarat factory address.
Provisional intent registration filed with District Industries Centre (DIC) prior to commercial production.
First-hand machinery invoices with GST proof of payment.
required_documents: Approved Project Report submitted to Bank / Financial Institution
Bank Term Loan Sanction Letter and Disbursement Certificate
Original OEM Invoices, Delivery Challans, and Payment Vouchers
Chartered Accountant Fixed Capital Investment Certificate
GPCB Consent to Establish / Operate (where applicable)

evidence.issuing_authority: Government of Gujarat Industries & Mines Department
evidence.exact_quote: Enterprises owned by women entrepreneurs or SC/ST entrepreneurs shall be entitled to an additional 5% capital subsidy within the overall ceiling of ₹25 Lakhs.

possible_relationships.description: Gujarat State Capital Subsidy explicitly permits stacking on top of Central CLCSS assistance without GFR conflict.
possible_relationships.statutory_non_duplication_clause: Resolution Section 12.1: 'Assistance under this resolution shall be over and above any central government subsidy received.'

evidence.issuing_authority: Government of Gujarat Industries & Mines Department
evidence.exact_quote: Assistance under this resolution shall be over and above any central government subsidy received.

application_process:
1. Enterprise registers on Gujarat Investor Facilitation Portal (ifp.gujarat.gov.in).
2. Files Common Application Form (CAF) with District Industries Centre (DIC).
3. Installs machinery and commences commercial production within approved timeline.
4. Submits final claim with CA investment certificate and bank verification within 1 year.
5. State Level Committee (SLC) approves and disburses subsidy via DBT into bank loan account.

source_documents.issuing_authority: Government of Gujarat Industries & Mines Department
source_documents.exact_quote: Scheme for financial assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises under Gujarat Industrial Policy 2020.
